description: This file defines a serializable class 'TestStoreGrainState' used for persistence in Orleans grains, including methods to generate random instances of its state for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestStoreGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class representing the state of a grain, with properties 'A', 'B', and 'C', and static methods to generate random states for testing.

methods.name: NewRandomState
methods.description: Creates a new GrainState containing a randomly initialized TestStoreGrainState, with optional length for the 'A' property.

methods.name: GenerateRandomDigitString
methods.description: Generates a random string of digits of specified length.
